name: login-01
title: Login 01
description: A taped sheet on the desk with a hand-written welcome back and Stubby looking over its top edge. Email, password with a show toggle, remember me and a Google button, checked with react-hook-form and zod. Sits on the desk (it brings its own) and reads the same on paper.

Installed the "Login 01" block into your components directory under blocks/login-01/.
Import it: import Login01Page from "<your components alias>/blocks/login-01/page"
Needs @hookform/resolvers@^5, react-hook-form@^7, zod@^4: the CLI installs them (a project on an older major is upgraded).
